trickyParts: A locator held across `setViewportSize` is a handle to a node, and this change makes 1280 px a remount boundary for every Inbox card: below it the card is the row's, from it the card is the column's. Any row that resolves a card at one width and acts on it at another must resolve it again after the switch. e2e/inbox-pane.ts's `askCard` is the helper that reads which layout a width draws; use it rather than `page.getByTestId('ask-<id>')` in a row that resizes.

A harness note, paid for the hard way this round: /legion/harness is shared by every role of the issue and only the databases are per lane. Its setup script now refuses to start Postgres while `pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 55432` answers, because neither obvious guard works across roles - `pg_ctl status` reads a pid file a pod move leaves stale, and `pgrep` cannot see another role's postmaster at all, since each role has its own PID namespace. Trusting the pid file started a second postmaster, whose failure to bind made the running one shut itself down; the tester lost nothing only because its measurements had already landed. The three facts are written above that guard in the script.
`ci-ok` condenses the selected lanes, so a red `ci-ok` names no cause: read the run's jobs with `filter=latest` before judging a return, or the one red lane is invisible behind it.
